title: Integrated Hilbert–Schmidt triangle inequalities for comparing planes (Simon 5.4.6 and 5.5.2 proof (7))
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ and E := ℝ^P (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin P)) with standard basis e_i := EuclideanSpace.single i 1 (i < P); let μ be a measure on E, τ : E → L(E, E) a map into the continuous linear maps E → E (operator-norm topology) that is μ-a.e. strongly measurable, A₁, A₂ : E → E continuous linear maps, and s ⊆ E any set. Put d := Σ_{i<P} ‖A₁e_i − A₂e_i‖² and, for k = 1, 2 and x ∈ E, f_k(x) := Σ_{i<P} ‖τ(x)e_i − A_k e_i‖². Then, with lower Lebesgue integrals in [0, ∞] over s (Lean ∫⁻ x in s, ENNReal.ofReal(…) ∂μ): (i) ofReal(d)·μ(s) ≤ 2∫_s ofReal(f_1) dμ + 2∫_s ofReal(f_2) dμ; and (ii) ∫_s ofReal(f_1) dμ ≤ 2∫_s ofReal(f_2) dμ + 2·ofReal(d)·μ(s).
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (τ : Euclid P → (Euclid P →L[ℝ] Euclid P)) (A₁ A₂ : Euclid P →L[ℝ] Euclid P) (s : Set (Euclid P)), AEStronglyMeasurable τ μ → ENNReal.ofReal (∑ i : Fin P, ‖A₁ (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) - A₂ (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))‖ ^ 2) * μ s ≤ 2 * (∫⁻ x in s, ENNReal.ofReal (∑ i : Fin P, ‖τ x (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) - A₁ (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))‖ ^ 2) ∂μ) + 2 * (∫⁻ x in s, ENNReal.ofReal (∑ i : Fin P, ‖τ x (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) - A₂ (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))‖ ^ 2) ∂μ) ∧ (∫⁻ x in s, ENNReal.ofReal (∑ i : Fin P, ‖τ x (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) - A₁ (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))‖ ^ 2) ∂μ) ≤ 2 * (∫⁻ x in s, ENNReal.ofReal (∑ i : Fin P, ‖τ x (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) - A₂ (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))‖ ^ 2) ∂μ) + 2 * ENNReal.ofReal (∑ i : Fin P, ‖A₁ (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) - A₂ (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))‖ ^ 2) * μ s
